dossier_requests.what: remove morocco from identity.successors (or give the dissolve no successor), so the 695 Marrakesh cells stay nobody's from the end of 1659 to July 1668
dossier_requests.why: the year-end dissolve hands the land to morocco, but the dossier's own note says morocco is 'successor in identity only' and morocco ledger /4 gains Marrakesh from nobody in July 1668; al-Rashid captured Marrakesh in July 1668 and before 1666 Alaouite rule was largely the Tafilalt

dossier_requests.what: ledger /96 (merge into commonwealth-of-england, May 1649) and commonwealth-of-england ledger /0 (found, England and Wales, May 1649) moved only 28 cells; at 1 January 1650 the kingdom holds 649 cells and the Commonwealth 28. Patched at 1 January 1650 inside p1650-p1659 (events/0); the true date is May 1649 and belongs in p1640-p1649
dossier_requests.why: Commonwealth page: the act of 19 May 1649 declared the people of England 'and of all the Dominions and Territories thereunto belonging' a Commonwealth

dossier_requests.what: narrow ledger /4 (vassal_end, region Hausaland) to the tributary lands so it does not release the Kebbi heartland; the 510 Zinder cells and other tribute land the state held to 1649 are nobody's from 1650
dossier_requests.why: Kebbi page: after 1556 the Hausa states stopped paying tribute; Kebbi was still 'one of the leading states in Hausaland' around 1800 and was defeated by Abdullahi dan Fodio only in 1808
